name: sickness
description: Something is causing the body or mind to not operate as well as it should.

variations.name: physical sickness
variations.description: An agent like a virus, a poison, or a genetic problem is negatively affecting the body's normal operation. The discomfort caused can range from easily ignorable to debilitating. Generally we seek rest and relief when sick.

variations.name: psychological sickness
variations.description: Poisons, diseases, or experiences perceived as traumatic can create mental problems ranging from difficulty focusing to difficulty functioning in society.

commentaries.quote: Just like there are hundreds of ways the body can have problems from small to big, there are likely hundreds of ways the mind can suffer. But we can't see mind problems with an x-ray.
If you or someone you know is experiencing severe psychological sickness, please contact an appropriate professional for help.

conditions: Difficulties in mental processing may be triggered by a traumatic event or by invading chemical.
Something is attacking the body, affecting its operation.
